name: Our Teacher Has A Micro
source: Story of a fresh out of university teacher, who just got his first job teaching math. Unfortunately for our hero, his micro penis gets exposed in front of the whole class before the first day even ends.
translation: 剛剛大學畢業的年輕教師找到了第一份工作，教數學。可惜他的運氣實在很差：上班頭一天還沒過完，全班就都看到了他那根小得可憐的陰莖。
